attempts.diagnosis:
Three seeded bugs in checkout.js:
1. `unit_amount` is set from the dollar-valued `PRICES` object, but Stripe expects integer cents. Fix: multiply by 100 (and round) when building line items.
2. `cartTotal` crashes when the cart is missing `items`, or when `items` is an empty array because it calls `.reduce()` on `undefined`. Fix: guard against missing `items` and treat it as an empty array.
3. `success_url` omits the required `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` placeholder. Fix: append the placeholder to the URL.
No changes are needed to server.js or the test suite.
